name: upstage-information-extract
description: Extracts schema checked JSON from one consented document through Upstage Information Extract.

upstage-information-extract.purpose: Extract schema checked fields from one document after consent.

inputContract.documentDataUrl: One base64 data URL for a user-approved document
inputContract.schemaName: JSON schema name (1–64 letters, digits, underscores, or dashes)
inputContract.schema: JSON schema using type, properties, required, items, enum, and additionalProperties
inputContract.consentToUpstage: Must be true after the user accepts sending this document to Upstage
